lesson: Profile V2 full vision build-out: interest tags, Where to Find Me, Contact This Station, On Air status, sidebar enhancements, and rich visitor/public profile view
When creating JSONB columns in Supabase before regenerating types, cast as 'unknown as Json' rather than 'unknown as TablesInsert<table>[column]' to avoid TS errors on missing column types
React hooks must always be called unconditionally - never place hooks after early returns. Move guard conditions after all hook calls
useMemo with an object param in the dependency array never caches because object identity changes each render - destructure to primitive values
Social links from Supabase profiles are untrusted user data - always validate URLs against safe protocols (http/https/mailto) before rendering as href
For parallel agent work, strict file ownership prevents merge conflicts - map which files each agent modifies before dispatching
ProfilePage.tsx is becoming a god file at 1174 lines - OtherProfileView should be extracted to its own file in a future refactor
Operating hours computation is duplicated 3x - should be consolidated into a shared useOperatingHours hook
